# Abraham Quiros Villalba

> Investment and innovation portfolio spanning renewable energy, blockchain, and clean energy entrepreneurship with deep expertise in utility-scale solar development.

Abraham Quiros Villalba is an investor and innovator with a documented career transition from the oil industry to utility-scale solar farms and cryptocurrency investments. The site showcases his investment thesis across clean energy, Bitcoin/blockchain technology, and Web3 innovation, with a focus on Texas-based solar development and sustainable energy infrastructure.
